name: Natural Events (NASA EONET + GDACS)
description: Global natural events including volcanoes, storms, floods, landslides, drought, and more from NASA EONET and GDACS with alert severity levels

eonet.purpose: Natural events (volcanoes, storms, floods, landslides). Earthquakes and wildfires excluded (separate overlays).
eonet.dataSent: Event status filter, optional day range and category
eonet.dataReceived: GeoJSON features with event title, description, date, magnitude, categories, source URLs

gdacs.purpose: Disaster events with alert levels; deduplicated against EONET (80km threshold)
gdacs.dataSent: Event type filter, date range, alert level filter
gdacs.dataReceived: GeoJSON features with event type/id, name, alert level/score, country, severity, report URLs
